task.description:
Execute fn:git-merge to manage GitHub feature branch to completion per CLAUDE.md GitHub Branch Management (MANDATORY).

Steps:
1. Create GitHub pull request:
   gh pr create --base main --title "fix(ISS-0112): add secret_ref to tenant webhook_subscriptions" --body "Fixes #375. Adds missing secret_ref and secret_key_id columns to webhook_subscriptions in SCHEMA-mode tenant schemas via migration 1134."

2. Ensure all checks pass (if any CI/CD workflows exist)

3. Merge and delete:
   gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch

4. Verify cleanup:
   git fetch origin && git branch -r | grep feature/WF03-gh375-20260804 || echo "✅ Branch deleted"

5. Return to main (MANDATORY):
   git checkout main
   git pull --ff-only origin main
   git branch --show-current  # must output: main
   git log --oneline -1       # should show squash-merge commit
   git status                 # must show clean working tree

6. Record in handoff result:
   - PR number
   - Merge commit SHA
   - Branch deletion confirmed
acceptance_criteria: PR number and merge SHA recorded

result.summary: GitHub feature branch merged to main via PR #413 (squash merge). Remote and local branches deleted. Repository returned to main with clean state.
result.next_action: Workflow WF03-gh375-20260804 complete. All artifacts merged to main.
